interface_water_definition: water-derived O with periodic z distance <= 3.3 A from either fixed first-frame outermost Pu-layer mean z (coverage-analysis criterion)
internal_water_definition: water-derived O with both corresponding distances > 3.3 A
rdf_centre_partner_definition: internal-water centre; all water-derived atoms are partners; self/currently-owned intramolecular pairs excluded where stated
D_label: LAMMPS type 3 is treated as deuterium; isotope mass does not enter a positional RDF
dynamic_D_assignment: nearest O with O-D distance <= 1.2 A; D owned by lattice O excluded from water RDF
normalization: local centre-partner RDF using water-accessible volume A_xy*(Lz-slab_span); shell=4*pi*r_mid^2*dr
normalization_caveat: Internal-water g(r) is suitable for bulk-D2O comparison. Interface-water curves would require boundary/accessibility corrections, so this internal version is reported.
